verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only documents troubleshooting help: AI-generated troubleshooting instructions and a guide to common Zap errors. Neither shows dedicated error-handling paths, error workflows, or alerts when a run fails. Troubleshooting guidance is an adjacent feature, not the capability itself, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails
